about_the_game: This is a visual novel set in an alternate historical world ruled by female leaders, where history bends into a thrilling fiction with no basis in reality. Dive into an alternate 18th-century saga where world female leaders clash in a dramatic struggle for power. In this game, the story begins with tragedy: General Georgina Washington, is executed by British forces, and her ally, France, falls to the might of Georgina III. Forcing France’s queen Louise XVI to abdicate, Georgina III crowns herself Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain, Ireland, and France. Yet from the ashes of defeat rises a young lady, Napoleon Bonaparte, a fiery Corsican determined to liberate France and challenge the British titan. This game features simple and relaxing gameplay, being solely a visual novel, with support for an achievement system, over a hundred exquisite illustrations, detailed character portrayals, unexpected emotional conflicts that surprise players, and a storyline that players will find difficult to predict.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes some suggestive artwork, as well as storylines featuring same-sex romance and marriage between female characters.

short_description: This is a female-led alternate history visual novel where all historical figures have their genders reversed. The story begins with General Georgina Washington’s execution, and France falling alongside Merica. A young lady, Napoleon Bonaparte rises to challenge Queen Georgina III of Britain.
